Tournament formats:
• Single elimination: one loss = out.
• Double elimination: your first loss drops you to the losers' bracket; two losses = out.
• Round robin: everyone plays everyone once.
• Swiss: each round you're paired with players on equal points, no elimination.
• League: home-and-away round robin (or more).
Win 3, draw 1 point. In knockouts, draws are decided by golden goal.

Each disc has two stats from 1 to 10:
• Power: scales max shot speed from 0.75× to 1.25×.
• Accuracy: the higher, the less random shot deviation (zero at 10, about ±4° at 1) and the longer the path preview.
These really apply in both offline and online play.
